# Le Pois Penché

> Parisian brasserie in downtown Montreal's Golden Square Mile, founded in 2008. French classics, exceptional steaks and seafood platters. Lunch, dinner and weekend brunch.

Address: 1230 boul. De Maisonneuve Ouest, Montréal, QC H3G 1M2, Canada (corner of Drummond, near Peel metro)
Phone: 514-667-5050
Email: info@lepoispenche.com
Reservations: https://www.opentable.ca/r/le-pois-penche-reservations-montreal?restref=25942
Cuisine: French brasserie, seafood, steak
Price range: $$$

## Hours
- Lunch: Tuesday to Friday, 11:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.
- Dinner: Sunday to Wednesday, 5 p.m. to 10 p.m.; Thursday to Saturday, 5 p.m. to 11 p.m.
- Brunch: Saturday and Sunday, 10:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.

## Facts
- Sidewalk terrace open in spring and summer, weather permitting.
- Kids welcome.
- Valet and paid parking at hotel Le Mount Stephen, 1440 Drummond St.
- Recognized among Montreal's best French restaurants by Time Out and Tourisme Montréal; among Canada's most popular brunches by OpenTable.
